mapper.sql: id, execution_id, request_id, proposer_id, approver_id, server_id, template_id, params_json, params_hash, rendered_command, status, source, risk_level, approval_mode, proposal_json, result_json, exit_code, truncated, duration_ms, error_code, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_command_runs (execution_id, request_id, proposer_id, server_id, template_id, params_json, params_hash, rendered_command, status, source, risk_level, approval_mode, proposal_json, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{run.executionId}, #{run.requestId}, #{run.proposerId}, #{run.serverId}, #{run.templateId}, #{run.paramsJson}, #{run.paramsHash}, #{run.renderedCommand}, #{run.status}, #{run.source}, #{run.riskLevel}, #{run.approvalMode}, #{run.proposalJson}, #{run.expiresAt}, #{run.createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_command_runs SET status = 'approved', approval_mode = 'auto' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'pending_approval'
UPDATE ai_command_runs SET status = 'executing' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'approved'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ai_command_runs WHERE status = 'pending_approval' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{batchSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalRuns, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending_approval' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusPendingApproval, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusApproved, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'executing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusExecuting, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusSucceeded, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusFailed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusRejected, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'expired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusExpired, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'timeout' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS statusTimeout, SUM(CASE WHEN approval_mode = 'auto' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvalModeAuto, SUM(CASE WHEN approval_mode = 'manual' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approvalModeManual, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS riskLevelLow, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'medium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS riskLevelMedium, SUM(CASE WHEN risk_level = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS riskLevelHigh, SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'ai' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sourceAi, SUM(CASE WHEN source = 'manual' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sourceManual, SUM(CASE WHEN approval_mode = 'auto' AND risk_level = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highRiskAuto, SUM(CASE WHEN approval_mode = 'auto' AND status IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'timeout') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS autoExecuted, SUM(CASE WHEN approval_mode = 'auto' AND status IN ('failed', 'timeout') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS autoFailed, SUM(CASE WHEN approval_mode = 'manual' AND status IN ('succeeded', 'failed', 'timeout') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manualExecuted, SUM(CASE WHEN approval_mode = 'manual' AND status IN ('failed', 'timeout') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS manualFailed, COUNT(DISTINCT server_id) AS distinctServers, AVG(duration_ms) AS avgDurationMs, MAX(duration_ms) AS maxDurationMs FROM ai_command_runs WHERE created_at >= #{windowStart}
SELECT template_id AS templateId, COUNT(*) AS runs FROM ai_command_runs WHERE created_at >= #{windowStart} GROUP BY template_id ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT #{limit}
